title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover the best social and recreational spots at Binghamton University that require no admission fees or purchases. From nature trails to late-night bowling, these student-friendly activities are completely free with a university ID.

cards.title: Hike the Nature Preserve
cards.subtitle: 190 acres of trails and wetlands
cards.notes: Explore 11 miles of maintained trails and a wooden footbridge over Harpur Pond. It is open daily from dawn to dusk for hiking and wildlife spotting.
cards.short_summary: A sprawling 190-acre natural area on campus featuring diverse ecosystems and extensive hiking trails.
cards.evidence_claim: The Nature Preserve includes a number of maintained hiking trails and a wooden footbridge and is free for the university community.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from dawn to dusk. Free parking in non-paid lots like Lot M on weekends.

cards.title: Browse the Art Museum
cards.subtitle: Global art in the Fine Arts Building
cards.notes: View a permanent collection of over 4,500 objects and rotating exhibitions. Admission is always free for students and the general public.
cards.short_summary: A public campus museum hosting diverse exhibitions and a significant permanent collection of global artworks.
cards.evidence_claim: The Binghamton University Art Museum offers a dynamic schedule of exhibitions that are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Visit the Art Museum - Binghamton University
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Saturday, 12:00 PM – 4:00 PM, with extended hours until 7:00 PM on Thursdays.

cards.title: Free Late Night Bowling
cards.subtitle: Bowling in the Union Undergrounds
cards.notes: Roll strikes with friends at the campus bowling alley. Undergraduate and graduate students bowl for free; shoe rentals are just 50 cents.
cards.short_summary: A student-focused bowling alley offering free lane access for currently enrolled Binghamton students.
cards.evidence_claim: Bowling is free for currently enrolled undergraduate and graduate students at The Lanes in the Union Undergrounds.
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight on Fridays and Saturdays. Student ID required for free access.

cards.entity_name: E.W. Heier Teaching and Research Greenhouse
cards.title: Visit the Exotic Greenhouse
cards.subtitle: Four biomes in the Science Complex
cards.notes: Walk through tropical, desert, and temperate environments housing over 6,000 plants. It is a warm, free escape during cold Binghamton winters.
cards.short_summary: A large campus greenhouse facility featuring four distinct climate zones and a massive collection of exotic plant species.
cards.evidence_claim: The greenhouse is open to the public Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 3:30 PM with no admission fee mentioned.
cards.source_title: Frequently Asked Questions | Greenhouse - Binghamton University
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 3:30 PM. Best for small groups of 10 or fewer.

cards.title: Relax on the Peace Quad
cards.subtitle: The central hub for campus events
cards.notes: Lounge on the grass or attend major free events like University Fest. It is the primary outdoor social space between the Union and Fine Arts.
cards.short_summary: A central campus green space used for student gatherings, outdoor studying, and large-scale university festivals.
cards.evidence_claim: The Peace Quad hosts major free events like University Fest and the Party on the Peace Quad for the campus community.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible 24/7; major events typically occur during the academic year.

cards.title: Workout at FitSpace
cards.subtitle: Free cardio and strength training
cards.notes: Access cardio equipment and the functional training zone for free. Just bring your Binghamton University ID card to enter the facility.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus fitness center offering free access to exercise equipment for all current students.
cards.evidence_claim: Students get FREE access to the FitSpace fitness center by showing their BingU ID card.
cards.access_notes: Located in the East Gym. Requires a valid student ID for entry.

cards.title: Study in the Memorial Courtyard
cards.subtitle: Quiet retreat in the Fine Arts Building
cards.notes: Find a bench under the willow tree in this enclosed courtyard. It is a peaceful, free spot for reading or de-stressing between classes.
cards.short_summary: A secluded outdoor courtyard located within the Fine Arts Building, known for its tranquil atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: The Memorial Courtyard is a hidden gem in the center of the Fine Arts Building, featuring benches and flowerbeds for relaxation.
cards.source_title: 13 Hidden Gems On Binghamton University's Campus
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Fine Arts Building operating hours, typically 7:00 AM – 11:00 PM.

cards.title: Watch a Free Movie
cards.subtitle: Weekly films in the Undergrounds
cards.notes: Catch popular pre-release films on Friday nights in the Union. Snacks are often provided, and admission is free for all current students.
cards.short_summary: A weekly film screening series for students featuring recent movies and free snacks in the University Union.
cards.evidence_claim: Late Nite Cinema is a weekly series featuring popular films on Friday nights, free for all current Binghamton University students.
cards.source_title: Late Nite | Campus Activities - Binghamton University
cards.access_notes: Friday nights during the academic year. Located in the Undergrounds Lounge.

cards.title: Attend a Skills Lab
cards.subtitle: Professional workshops for all majors
cards.notes: Join 90-minute hands-on workshops led by industry professionals. Learn skills like data analytics or project management at no cost.
cards.short_summary: Free professional development workshops hosted by the career center to help students gain industry-relevant skills.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fleishman Center's Skills Lab program provides free workshops for students to learn industry-relevant skills.
cards.source_title: Skills Labs | Fleishman Career Center - Binghamton University
cards.access_notes: Workshops are held throughout the semester; registration via hireBING is usually required.

cards.title: Play Open Gym Sports
cards.subtitle: Basketball, pickleball, and swimming
cards.notes: Drop in for open swim or court sports like basketball and pickleball. Equipment like balls and racquets can be checked out for free with an ID.
cards.short_summary: Free access to gym courts and the pool for recreational use, including complimentary sports equipment loans.
cards.evidence_claim: The East Gym offers free recreational activities, including open swim, pickleball and basketball, with a student ID.
cards.source_title: 10 Campus Hacks to Help Make the Most of Your Time at Binghamton!
cards.access_notes: Check the B-Engaged app for weekly open recreation and pool schedules.
